campaign.surfaceSet: R9-R03 frozen split integration: all 16 source-audit feature definitions, linked requirement parent cases and PDP0-501 crosswalk traces; packet capability repairs checked for R9-R02 immutability.

verifiedFacts.detail: R9-R03 freeze, candidate bundle, reused R9-R02 operation ledger/schema/projection, all seven source preimages and all four selected postimages match their recorded SHA-256 pins. R03 candidate postimages match the frozen values.

The frozen cut retains 16 feature audit identities across 18 integrated definitions including two unchanged packet capabilities; feature cases 52, feature requirement parents 54, 501 crosswalk rows, 462 historical owner rows and the 248-operation retained projection are conserved. Each of the 16 crosswalk rows remains BOUND_EXISTING with leaf evidence references and correct owner surface. R03 changes only nine listed feature definitions; capability-leaf-review is unchanged and crosswalk postimage is identical to R9-R02.

All 54 feature parent rows resolve through sourceCapabilityCaseId to the correct capability and preserve polarity. Nine R03-repaired feature pairs have literal given/when/then parity. Seven inherited R7 feature pairs retain the same invoked operation and given/then but parent when adds a non-invocation Parent relation annotation, so full-string exact when parity is false; see F-06.

Positive case now includes concrete permitted versioned evidence with HOSTED placement and observable fields for evidence, policy decision, provider binding and placement; the result disclaims actual authority. Negative contract contradicts itself by nesting “returns UNKNOWN” under REJECTED.conditions while also exposing UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; see F-07.
R03 freeze pins the R9-R02 freeze, bundle, operation ledger/schema, retained projection and actual H review; their recorded hashes match. R03 does not rewrite any R02 artifacts or canonical files.

Live PDP-0 status remains IN_PROGRESS at the verified status hash, with zero outstandingMeaningIds but nine stale and 21 missing source pins out of 188. Owner decision, root adoption, schema registration and apply authorization remain unset. This candidate review does not establish Discovery completion or grant adoption/application authority.

findings.ownerSurface: Seven physical capability definitions and their linked requirement parent cases
findings.location: R03 capability postimage acceptanceCases and the linked requirement acceptanceCases identified by sourceCapabilityCaseId; parent when strings append “Parent relation: <requirement> includes capability <capability-id>.”
findings.finding: The invoked operation is the same in each leaf and parent case, and identities/polarities/given/then are conserved. However, the seven inherited parent when values are not exactly equal to their leaf when values because they append a relationship annotation. The new R03 pairs repaired for F-01 through F-04 do have literal parity.
findings.repair: Make each linked parent when exactly equal to its leaf when. Preserve requirement membership using the existing sourceCapabilityId/sourceCapabilityCaseId links and crosswalk evidence references instead of embedding relation metadata in the invocation string.
findings.predecessor: R9-R03 frozen integrated candidate; these seven pairs are inherited from the prior integrated source cut.
findings.acceptanceCriterion: For all 16 feature definitions, every linked parent case maps to the correct leaf case and has byte-equal polarity, given, when and then; preserve source audit IDs, requirement ownership and all 501 crosswalk rows.
findings.nextLegalAction: Repair only the seven candidate PDP-0 parent when fields, refresh affected candidate projections, and submit a new frozen cut for independent review. No canonical apply or phase-status change.

findings.location: R03 capabilities postimage: MEDIA-P0-COHORT02-AUD-GEN-024-LEAF-NEG then; linked MEDIA-P0-COHORT02-AUD-GEN-024-MEDIA-REQ-CAP-CAPABILITY-NEG parent then.
findings.finding: The negative contract places “Missing, stale, or ambiguous provider-class evidence returns UNKNOWN” inside REJECTED.conditions, then separately exposes UNKNOWN_OUTCOME for unresolved finality. This assigns the same missing/stale/ambiguous condition to REJECTED and UNKNOWN, leaving the output disposition ambiguous.
findings.repair: Define disjoint negative outcome conditions. Map missing, stale or ambiguous provider/license/rights evidence to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME (or a separately named UNKNOWN result) and reserve REJECTED for an explicit invalid, unsupported or denied request. Mirror the corrected branch exactly in leaf and parent. Retain the positive mixed-axis fixture and the no-authority claim.
findings.predecessor: R9-R03 frozen integrated candidate; prior R02 F-05 requested observable mixed-axis evidence and preservation of UNKNOWN behavior.
findings.acceptanceCriterion: For missing/stale/ambiguous evidence exactly one unambiguous UNKNOWN result is specified; REJECTED conditions do not contain UNKNOWN outcomes; leaf and parent outcomes and case polarity match exactly. Positive output records the versioned evidence and policy decision, provider binding, and LOCAL/HOSTED placement axes independently.
findings.nextLegalAction: Repair the GEN-024 candidate leaf and linked parent negative output branch, then submit a new frozen cut for independent review; no canonical apply or phase-status change.
